This report lists every control of the selected baseline, the authored
technical checks mapped to it, and the evidence observed for them. It is
not a compliance verdict: no control, statement, or baseline is marked
satisfied. Automation "partial" means at least one selected check is
mapped, bounded by its authored coverage limit; "none" means no technical
mapping, so no automated assessment (not passing, not not-applicable);
"unselected" means mapped checks exist but the profile selects none;
"unknown" means a mapping could not be resolved. Evidence counts are
unique observations per row and are not additive across rows.
